newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rupee ends down in kerb, seen weak.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rupee ends down in kerb, seen weak.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee opened 0.03 up at 41.30 to the dollar on Tuesday, but dealers said it would weaken towards the close on higher dollar demand.

"The dollar has opened slightly weak, but it will gain later today on higher demand," dealer Owais Kalia said. "The dollar is moving in a narrow band for the last month and this trend is likely to continue."

The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on July 11, was 40.5200/40.7226 against the dollar. The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates opened at 2.10 percent from 2.20 on Monday. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
